units.text: 补充保障收入（SSI）是一项向收入和资源有限的残疾成年人和儿童支付福利的计划。
supporting_chunk_ids: Supplemental Security Income (SSI) Benefits | Social Security Administration#2_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states: 'The Supplemental Security Income (SSI) program pays benefits to disabled adults and children who have limited income and resources.'

units.text: 年满65岁且无残疾但符合财务限制的人也有资格获得SSI福利。
supporting_chunk_ids: Supplemental Security Income (SSI) Benefits | Social Security Administration#2_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states: 'SSI benefits also are payable to people 65 and older without disabilities who meet the financial limits.'

units.text: 工作年限足够长的人可能同时获得社会保障残疾或退休福利以及SSI。
supporting_chunk_ids: Supplemental Security Income (SSI) Benefits | Social Security Administration#2_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states: 'People who have worked long enough may also be able to receive Social Security disability or retirement benefits as well as SSI.'
